question: What is ResilioHub and how does it work?
answer: ResilioHub connects your WhatsApp number to a unified platform where you can broadcast campaigns, run chatbots, and manage every conversation with your team — all in one dashboard.

question: Do I need a verified WhatsApp Business account?
answer: For official API features and bulk campaigns, a WhatsApp Business API account is recommended. You can also connect instantly via WhatsApp QR for quick setup.

question: Can I manage Instagram too?
answer: Yes. The unified inbox brings Instagram conversations alongside WhatsApp, so your team replies from a single place.

question: Can I broadcast messages to thousands of contacts?
answer: Absolutely. Upload your phonebook, pick a Meta-approved template, and send bulk campaigns to thousands of contacts in minutes — then track delivery and open rates.

question: How does the chatbot builder work?
answer: Drag and drop triggers, conditions, and actions onto a visual canvas — no code required. Connect webhooks and templates to automate replies, qualify leads, and route conversations.

question: How much does ResilioHub cost?
answer: ResilioHub plans are Monthly ₹1,499 (30 days), Quarterly ₹3,999 (90 days), Half Yearly ₹6,999 (180 days) and Yearly ₹9,999 (365 days). Every plan includes all features, with no hidden fees, and you can cancel anytime.

question: Is there a free trial for ResilioHub?
answer: Yes. ResilioHub offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. Sign up at https://resiliohub.com/signup/.

question: How can I contact ResilioHub support?
answer: Email support@resiliohub.com or call/WhatsApp +91 92019 96372. Sales, technical support and onboarding are available Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST.

question: Is there a ResilioHub mobile app?
answer: Yes. ResilioHub is available on Google Play for Android and on the Apple App Store for iPhone.

question: How do I delete my ResilioHub account?
answer: Email the support team from your registered address with the subject line "Delete my account", including the email or phone number on the account. After identity confirmation, the account is deactivated immediately and permanently removed within 24 hours. Remaining wallet balance and unused plan days are forfeited with no refund.

question: What channels does ResilioHub support?
answer: ResilioHub's unified inbox supports WhatsApp Business API, WhatsApp QR and Instagram Direct, plus REST API, webhooks and Meta templates.

question: Who makes ResilioHub?
answer: ResilioHub is built and powered by ResilienceSoft, a Meta Tech Partner for the WhatsApp Business API.

question: Does ResilioHub have video tutorials?
answer: Yes. The Tutorials page has short videos and plain instructions for every core ResilioHub feature, such as inbox, campaigns, templates and contacts. You can filter them by topic, language and platform (web or mobile).

question: Can I book a live demo of ResilioHub?
answer: Yes. Use the Book a live demo button on the website, or book a call from the Contact page, and a ResilioHub expert will walk you through the product.

question: Which tools and integrations does ResilioHub connect with?
answer: ResilioHub connects WhatsApp Business API, WhatsApp QR, Instagram, a REST API, webhooks, a QR REST API, WA forms, Meta templates and chatbots.

question: What standout features does ResilioHub have?
answer: Standout features include chatbot automation, REST API access, contact tagging, conversation notes, a WhatsApp warmer, a QR REST API, an Instagram inbox and WA forms.

question: How long does it take to set up ResilioHub?
answer: ResilioHub says you can set up in less than 5 minutes.

question: Is the ResilioHub FAQ available in Hindi?
answer: Yes. The FAQ page is available in English and Hindi.

question: Who can I talk to about sales, technical support or onboarding?
answer: The Contact page covers sales, technical support and onboarding. Fill out the form or book a call, or reach ResilioHub on +91 92019 96372 or support@resiliohub.com.

question: What is ResilioHub's privacy policy?
answer: ResilioHub collects only what it needs to run the service: account details (name, email, mobile number, encrypted login), message metadata, device information and an optional notification token. It does not sell or rent personal data, and does not use your data for advertising without consent. The full policy is at resiliohub.com/privacy-policy.

question: Does ResilioHub sell my data or read my messages?
answer: No. ResilioHub does not sell or rent personal data, and does not read, sell or share message content for advertising. Message content is processed transiently only to show your conversations and is not stored or analyzed for any other purpose.

question: How does ResilioHub keep my data secure?
answer: Data is stored with industry-standard safeguards, access is limited to authorized systems, and encryption is used where applicable. No system is 100% secure.

question: Can I ask ResilioHub to delete or correct my data?
answer: Yes. You can request access, correction or deletion of your data, and you can ask for account deletion. Email support@resiliencesoft.com, or follow the steps on the Delete Account page.

question: Is ResilioHub meant for children?
answer: No. ResilioHub is not intended for users under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from children.

question: Does ResilioHub support Telegram?
answer: No. ResilioHub does not support Telegram. Its channels are WhatsApp Business API, WhatsApp QR and Instagram Direct. For other channels, contact support@resiliohub.com.
